raw: {"note": "Setting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' would include shard 10, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD = 10), so the model would be training on its own validation data and val_bpb would no longer measure real generalization.", "verdict": "warn"}

parsed.note: Setting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' would include shard 10, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD = 10), so the model would be training on its own validation data and val_bpb would no longer measure real generalization.
